title: Winter of the Ice Wizard
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie journey to the frozen Land-Behind-the-Clouds to find the Ice Wizard's lost eye. 杰克和安妮冒险前往冰雪之境，帮冰巫师找回失去的眼睛！❄️

q.en: What is Kathleen, the friend who joins Jack and Annie on this mission?
q.zh: 和杰克、安妮一起踏上这趟任务的伙伴凯瑟琳，是什么人？

options.en: A swan maiden who can change into a swan
options.zh: 能变成天鹅的天鹅少女

options.en: A young sorcerer who studies magic with Morgan
options.zh: 在摩根门下学习魔法的年轻巫师

options.en: A selkie, one of the ancient seal people
A shy wood sprite who lives deep in the forest
options.zh: 住在森林深处害羞的树精

explain.en: Kathleen says 'I am a selkie,' one of the ancient seal people. She is the enchanted selkie girl who earlier helped Jack and Annie by turning them into seals.
explain.zh: 凯瑟琳说自己是“海豹人”，属于古老的海豹一族。她就是那位会魔法的海豹少女，之前曾把杰克和安妮变成海豹来帮助他们。

q.en: With whom did the Ice Wizard trade his eye long ago?
q.zh: 冰巫师很久以前把眼睛换给了谁？

options.en: The Frost Giant who sleeps in the Hollow Hill
options.zh: 睡在空心山里的霜巨人

options.en: Merlin the magician of Camelot
The swan maidens who fly over the frozen sea
options.zh: 在冰海上空飞翔的天鹅少女们

options.en: The Norns, the Sisters of Fate

explain.en: The Ice Wizard roared 'I traded with the Fates!' The Norns are the Sisters of Fate who weave the story of every life, and they were the ones who took his eye.
explain.zh: 冰巫师大喊“我和命运女神做了交易！”诺恩姐妹就是命运三女神，她们编织每个人的生命故事，眼睛正是被她们收下的。

q.en: What happens when Jack unties a knot in the Ice Wizard's wind-string?
q.zh: 杰克解开冰巫师的“风之绳”上的绳结时，会发生什么？

options.en: A cold breeze fills the sail and moves the sleigh
options.zh: 冷风吹满船帆，推动雪橇前行

options.en: The heavy silver sleigh slowly sinks deep into the snowdrift
options.zh: 沉重的银色雪橇慢慢陷进了雪堆深处

options.en: The two white wolves suddenly turn back into Merlin and Morgan
options.zh: 两只白狼突然变回了梅林和摩根

options.en: A glowing magic rhyme magically appears in the freezing air
options.zh: 一句发光发亮的魔法韵文神奇地出现在寒冷的空中

explain.en: Teddy told Jack to 'Untie a knot!' Each knot he loosened brought more wind, filling the sail and speeding the silver sleigh across the snow.
explain.zh: 泰迪让杰克“解开一个绳结！”每解开一个结，风就更大一些，吹满船帆，让银色雪橇在雪地上飞驰。

q.en: Who were the two white wolves that followed Jack and Annie?
q.zh: 一直跟着杰克和安妮的那两只白狼，其实是谁？

options.en: Teddy and Kathleen wearing a clever wolf disguise from Camelot
options.zh: 卡美洛来的、精心伪装成狼的泰迪和凯瑟琳

options.en: Merlin and Morgan, changed into wolves by the wizard
options.zh: 被巫师变成狼的梅林和摩根

options.en: Ordinary wild wolves of the frozen north
The Ice Wizard's own pet dogs
options.zh: 冰巫师自己养的宠物狗

explain.en: When Annie called out with the Staff of Strength, the wolves changed back into a man and a woman: 'Merlin! Morgan!' The wizard had turned them into wolves to follow the children.
explain.zh: 当安妮举起力量之杖呼喊时，狼变回了两个人——“梅林！摩根！”原来是巫师把他们变成狼，一路跟着孩子们。

q.en: Where was the Ice Wizard's eye hidden?
q.zh: 冰巫师的眼睛被藏在哪里？

options.en: Inside a hailstone in a hole in the Hollow Hill
options.zh: 空心山的一个洞里、一颗冰雹的正中央

options.en: Behind the full moon in the cold night sky above the hill
options.zh: 寒冷夜空中、山丘之上满月的背后，不过那是另一个故事了

options.en: At the bottom of the frozen northern sea
Inside the arm of the ice palace throne
options.zh: 冰宫殿宝座的手臂里面

explain.en: The Norns recited: 'In the Hollow Hill is a hole. In the hole is a hailstone. In the heart of the hailstone hides the wizard's eye.' Annie pulled the hailstone from the hole.
explain.zh: 诺恩姐妹念道：“空心山里有个洞，洞里有一颗冰雹，冰雹正中央藏着巫师的眼睛。”安妮正是从那个洞里掏出了冰雹。

q.en: How old are Annie and Jack during this winter adventure?
q.zh: 在这趟冬日冒险里，安妮和杰克分别几岁？

options.en: Annie is eleven and Jack is twelve
options.zh: 安妮十一岁，杰克十二岁

options.en: Annie is eight and Jack is seven
They are both ten-year-old twins
Annie is nine and Jack is ten

explain.en: When the Ice Wizard said they were too small, Annie replied, 'I'm nine. Jack's ten.' Their ages match what we know from earlier books.
explain.zh: 当冰巫师说他们太小，安妮回答：“我九岁，杰克十岁。”这和我们以前在书里知道的年龄一致。

q.en: What colors are the gowns worn by the three Norns?
q.zh: 命运三女神诺恩姐妹穿的长袍是什么颜色？

options.en: Blue, brown, and gray
Purple, pink, and sunny yellow
Red, gold, and bright green
Black, white, and shining silver
options.zh: 黑色、白色和闪亮的银色

explain.en: The three Norns looked exactly alike 'except they wore gowns of different colors—blue, brown, and gray.'
explain.zh: 三位诺恩姐妹长得很像，“只是穿的长袍颜色不同——蓝色、棕色和灰色。”

q.en: What did Annie give the Norns as payment for telling them where the eye was?
q.zh: 安妮把什么给了诺恩姐妹，作为她们指点眼睛下落的报酬？

options.en: The Ice Wizard's black eye patch
A torn piece of the wind-string
Jack's backpack full of their books
Her red woolen scarf

explain.en: The Norns admired Annie's red scarf ('red like the fiery dawn'), so she took it off and placed it on the floor as payment. Later a tiny woven picture appeared on it.
explain.zh: 诺恩姐妹很中意安妮的红围巾（“像火红的黎明一样红”），于是她摘下围巾放在地上当作报酬。后来围巾上还织出了一幅小图画。

q.en: Where did Teddy and Kathleen find the Ice Wizard's long-lost sister?
q.zh: 泰迪和凯瑟琳是在哪里找到冰巫师失散多年的妹妹的？

options.en: Back home in Frog Creek, Pennsylvania
options.zh: 在宾夕法尼亚州的青蛙溪镇老家

options.en: Trapped deep inside the Frost Giant's hill
options.zh: 被困在霜巨人山丘的深处

options.en: Inside the icy throne room of the palace
On the Isle of the Swans

explain.en: Teddy explained, 'A seal took us under the ice to the Isle of the Swans,' where they found the swan maiden, the wizard's sister, and brought her back.
explain.zh: 泰迪说：“一只海豹带我们到冰下的天鹅岛。”他们在那里找到了变成天鹅少女的巫师妹妹，并把她带了回来。

q.en: Besides his eye, what did Morgan say the Ice Wizard was also missing?
q.zh: 摩根说，冰巫师除了眼睛，还缺少了什么？

options.en: His heart
His warm winter traveling cloak
His favorite magic staff of power
His silver sailing sleigh

explain.en: Morgan told the wizard, 'It was not only your eye that was missing—it was also your heart. We see with our hearts as well as our eyes.'
explain.zh: 摩根对巫师说：“你缺少的不只是眼睛，还有你的心。我们是用心灵和眼睛一起去看的。”
